definitions.explanation: The record of when employees come to work, leave, take breaks, and are absent. Used in workplace management.

examples.japanese: {勤怠|きんたい}{管理|かんり}⟦システム→システム：08428_shisutemu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{導入|どうにゅう}した→導入する：16055_dounyuusuru⟧。
examples.english: We introduced an attendance management system.

examples.japanese: {勤怠|きんたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記録|きろく}する→記録する：25341_kirokusuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れた→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: I forgot to record my attendance.

examples.japanese: {勤怠|きんたい}データ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{月末|げつまつ}→月末：00070_getsumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦まとめて→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧。
examples.english: I compile and submit my attendance data at the end of the month.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{勤|きん} (diligence, work) + {怠|たい} (laziness, neglect) - the kanji represent both working and not working, covering the full spectrum of attendance.

USAGE:
Business term for tracking:
- Arrival/departure times
- Late arrivals (⟦{遅刻|ちこく}→遅刻：03465_chikoku⟧)
- Early departures (⟦{早退|そうたい}→早退：05767_soutai⟧)
- Absences (⟦{欠勤|けっきん}→欠勤：07732_kekkin⟧)
- Overtime (⟦{残業|ざんぎょう}→残業：01071_zangyou⟧)

COMPOUNDS:
- {勤怠|きんたい}{管理|かんり} - attendance management
- {勤怠|きんたい}⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧ - attendance record
- {勤怠|きんたい}⟦システム→システム：08428_shisutemu⟧ - attendance system

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{欠勤|けっきん}→欠勤：07732_kekkin⟧ - absence from work
- ⟦{出勤|しゅっきん}→出勤：04548_shukkin⟧ - going to work
